registry.name: record
registry.doc: Open-ended recording. Runs until you press Stop or the time set to stop after has passed, ten minutes by default. Use the marker buttons to timestamp events as they happen.

registry.name: protocol
registry.doc: Custom cued protocol. One step per line: 'cue text | seconds'. The steps run as many times as the repetitions set. Each cue is timestamped, and spoken when the cue at each change is speech.

params.name: steps
params.default:
Close your eyes | 20
Open your eyes | 20

registry.name: blink
registry.doc: Cued blinks. Electrodes at the forehead typically see a blink of 100 to 300 uV. Sham trials ('stay still') control for the cue itself.

registry.name: jaw_clench
registry.doc: Cued jaw clench. Electrodes at the temples sit over the temporalis muscle, where a clench is typically broadband EMG an order of magnitude above baseline in 20-200 Hz.

registry.name: saccade
registry.doc: Cued left/right eye movements. The eye is a dipole, so electrodes at the left and right temples deflect in opposite directions, and the signs reverse with the direction of the movement.

registry.name: head_training
registry.doc: Train a head to tell two or more states apart: one of the pairs of states offered, or, with the pair set to own, the person's own states, written one to a line as 'name | cue words'. Reps go through the states in turn, each cued aloud and lasting the rep length plus four of the device's windows, of which up to the rep length are kept, labeled by the state cued. A head is trained on every window kept, and scored, where enough can be held out, by heads each trained without one block of the windows and tested on that block. The head is not put on the device: that is done separately, into a slot the person chooses.

params.name: states
params.default:
Relaxed | Relax. Breathe slowly and let your mind wander.
Mental math | Mental arithmetic. Start at three hundred and keep subtracting seven.
